title: Solid fuel-burning appliances.
officialText:
The clearance reduction methods specified in Table 308.6 shall not be utilized to reduce the
clearance required for solid fuel-burning appliances that are labeled for installation with clearances of 12 inches (305 mm) or less.
Where appliances are labeled for installation with clearances of greater than 12 inches (305 mm), the clearance reduction methods of
Table 308.6 shall not reduce the clearance to less than 12 inches (305 mm).
